analysis.title: Quant Driven Earnings Ideas – Stocks Poised for Earnings Surprises in November 2026
key_insights: MS quant team lists Overweight-rated stocks with top-quintile Earnings Surprise Composite scores and Underweight or Equal-weight stocks in the bottom quintiles, for companies expected to report between 5 Nov and 1 Dec 2026.

The Earnings Surprise Composite combines three signals: Earnings Forecast Landscape, Earnings Quality, and Broader Forecast Dynamics. It is combined with fundamental analyst ratings in a 'quantamental' approach.
Top US names by composite percentile: Analog Devices (0.99), Deere (0.94), Everpure (0.94), Hewlett Packard Enterprise (0.92), Snowflake (0.88).
Top European names by composite percentile: ABN AMRO (1.00), ACS (0.97), Euronext (0.93), Richemont (0.88), EDP (0.87), ArcelorMittal (0.82).
Lowest US composite scores among UW/EW-rated names: Charter Communications (0.05), NRG Energy (0.08), Zscaler (0.29), TransDigm (0.38).
Lowest European composite scores among UW/EW-rated names: Smith & Nephew (0.05), Swisscom (0.08, UW), Veolia (0.09), Alstom (0.15), Imperial Brands (0.20), Wise (0.22).
Live performance since 2026: the strategy is down 3.7% in the US and up 10.1% in Europe.
Since 2024, pre-cost Sharpe ratio is 0.66 for the US and 0.95 for Europe. Since 2019 it is 0.59 for the US and 0.74 for Europe.
No trading is assumed in December because few stocks report. The next round refreshes in January 2027.
Return distribution is negatively skewed with fat tails: since 2019 skewness is -0.71 and excess kurtosis 8.11 in the US. Max drawdown is -12.4% in the US and -11.9% in Europe since 2019.

earnings_insights: Earnings Surprise Composite is a quant forecast of earnings surprise odds, not a consensus estimate. Reports are expected between 5 Nov and 1 Dec 2026.

Top US composite scores (percentile) with expected report dates: ADI 0.99 (23-Nov), DE 0.94 (24-Nov), P 0.94 (17-Nov), HPE 0.92 (22-Nov), SNOW 0.88 (1-Dec), OKTA 0.71 (30-Nov), CRWD 0.65 (30-Nov), PPL 0.65 (5-Nov), WMT 0.64 (18-Nov), TGT 0.62 (17-Nov).
Bottom US composite scores for EW-rated names: CHTR 0.05 (5-Nov), NRG 0.08 (8-Nov), ZS 0.29 (23-Nov), TDG 0.38 (9-Nov).

Top European composite scores: ABN AMRO 1.00 (11-Nov), ACS 0.97 (11-Nov), Euronext 0.93 (5-Nov), Richemont 0.88 (13-Nov), EDP 0.87 (6-Nov), ArcelorMittal 0.82 (5-Nov), UniCredit 0.66 (8-Nov), Orsted 0.63 (5-Nov), Poste Italiane 0.62 (11-Nov).

Bottom European composite scores: Smith & Nephew 0.05 (6-Nov), Swisscom 0.08 (5-Nov), Veolia 0.09 (5-Nov), Alstom 0.15 (17-Nov), Imperial Brands 0.20 (17-Nov), Wise 0.22 (12-Nov), United Utilities 0.24 (12-Nov), ENEL 0.25 (12-Nov), Cellnex 0.29 (5-Nov), Buzzi 0.32 (5-Nov), Severn Trent 0.33 (18-Nov), Millicom 0.34 (5-Nov), Snam 0.37 (11-Nov), Generali 0.38 (13-Nov).
The report lists expected earnings dates only. It gives no EPS or revenue figures.

trade_ideas.description: Long US Overweight-rated stocks in the top quintiles of the Earnings Surprise Composite, short Underweight or Equal-weight stocks in the bottom quintiles, ahead of November earnings (quantamental earnings surprise strategy)
trade_ideas.rationale: The composite combines Earnings Forecast Landscape, Earnings Quality and Broader Forecast Dynamics signals with analyst ratings.
trade_ideas.risk: Strategy is down 3.7% in the US in 2026. US max drawdown is -12.4% since 2019 and the return distribution has negative skew.

trade_ideas.description: Long European Overweight-rated stocks in the top quintiles of the Earnings Surprise Composite, short Underweight or Equal-weight stocks in the bottom quintiles, ahead of November earnings
trade_ideas.rationale: The same composite and analyst-rating screen applied to MSCI Europe has the stronger live record, up 10.1% in 2026.
trade_ideas.risk: Europe max drawdown is -11.9% since 2019, with 1% monthly CVaR of -7.5%.

risk_factors: Past performance is hypothetical and does not predict future results.

Monthly hit rate is 62.2% in the US and 61.4% in Europe since 2019. Live since 2024 it is 62.7% in the US and 65.0% in Europe.
